scope: Independent untouched Wan2.1 CPU FP32 source references for the declared synthetic shape domain. Actual physical source/reference media were unavailable. These files do not establish original BF16 arithmetic, generated-video quality, real-media parity, or production WASM acceptance.

shapeAuthority.sourceRule: Source actual supplied F capped by target81; source area/center resize to480x832 precedes this VAE boundary. Never infer actual F from target cap.
shapeAuthority.referenceRule: Long edge848, stride16, Python ties-to-even, minimum16 each dimension, area interpolation and crop disabled. Reference cases below are already-preprocessed RGB dimensions; no resizing is performed by the oracle.
shapeAuthority.sourceIds: Target0; supplied source video then reference video then ascending original slot/frame contexts IDs1+. Each image-batch frame is separate, wired wins, duplicates retained. This per-case oracle does not invent absent media or IDs.

model.precision: Stored BF16 weights are unchanged and expanded to FP32; no claim of original BF16 arithmetic equivalence.

source.oracle: Direct untouched vendor WanVAE_.encode/decode calls on CPU, raw scale[0,1]; no stream_program, ONNX export, or production runtime as oracle.

comparisonGate.scope: New declared FP32 synthetic shape domain; proposed before comparison, not transferred from tiny-model tolerances.

comparisonPolicy: Compare every finite output element and exact shape. Require abs(error)<=atol+rtol*abs(reference) and global maxAbs<=maxAbs. Chunk/file comparison may replace full RAM arrays; no frame/pixel/channel subset. A written source reference is not a numerical pass.

encodeInput.origin: Synthetic deterministic literal RGB, already at the declared VAE boundary; no padding, crop, resize, or frame reduction.

decodeInput.meaning: Deterministic independent unnormalized raw latent; neither a posterior sample nor an asserted Diffusion-produced sample. Producer evidence is not required for normal raw decode.

decodeOutput.meaning: Raw RGB, no output clipping or normalization

temporalContract.inputFrames: Actual literal F; unchanged in the saved RGB input
temporalContract.scope: The unchanged fixed source consumes first1 followed by complete groups4. F4 retains an F4 input file but processes1; F80 retainsF80 and processes77. This is explicitly reported, not hidden padding/reduction.

executionPolicy.privateOutputs: Fresh coordinator-selected /tmp scratch; all RGB input, mean output, independent raw decode input, raw RGB reference values retained in little-endian FP32 NCTHW files.
executionPolicy.memory: Observe actual Linux cgroup memory.max/current plus worker RSS/PSS. Scratch page cache counts toward cgroup memory. Supervisor owns and can terminate only its own worker; source leaf-module hooks report progress and observed reserve crossings.
executionPolicy.reserveScope: Explicit supervisor operational reserve, not a claimed model requirement. RSS/PSS sampling may miss transient peaks; source allocation failure remains a failed reference, not a completed case.
executionPolicy.errors: Record stage, exception/worker termination, completed files, actual frame mapping and sampled resource log. Do not replace failed large cases by smaller input or post-result tolerance changes.
